subject: Next steps: SIG prefill, MAP, and evidence ownership
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Eva Martinez <eva@medallionhealth.com>, Gavin Lee <gavin.lee@medallionhealth.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-09-12T16:08:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up & MAP: SIG prefill options + a couple clarifying questions

Hi Eva / Gavin —

Great to meet you both earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call:

- Goal: get Medallion through our security intake (SIG/CAIQ/custom) so your security team can complete review ahead of the Oct pilot.
- Immediate asks for you: confirm existing compliance posture (SOC 2 type II in progress? final date), whether you need HIPAA-specific hosting commitments, and who on your side will own evidence collection for the SIG prefill.

Action items I can take now:
1) Send our SIG prefill template (attached) + a short guide on what we typically provide vs what customers supply.
2) Propose a mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones — signature/contract, SIG delivery, evidence review, pilot start.
3) Loop in our security ops for any technical evidence follow-ups (I cc'd Ben).

Questions for you:
- Do you need a self-hosted/private deployment for HIPAA, or is VPC-hosted with Business Associate Agreement acceptable?
- Is your SOC 2 currently in progress or already completed? If in progress, what is the expected report date?
- Who should be the primary evidence owner on your side?

If it helps, I can propose a 2-week MAP that lines up deliverables with your procurement timeline.

Thanks — I attached the prefill and a short SOC2 summary from our side.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0147

Attachments: redwood_sig_prefill_template.xlsx (SIG prefill template), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (SOC 2 snapshot)

From: Eva Martinez <eva@medallionhealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Gavin Lee <gavin.lee@medallionhealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T17:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & MAP: SIG prefill options + a couple clarifying questions

Hi Lauren —

Thanks for the clear recap and for sending the attachments. Quick answers:

- SOC 2 status: we have Type II in progress; audit firm expects final report by 2026-11-12. We can share interim controls evidence sooner.
- HIPAA: we are covered by HIPAA and would prefer a VPC-hosted option with a BAA rather than on-prem right now.
- Evidence owner: Gavin will be the point person for evidence collection. I'll loop in our procurement/legal as needed but Gavin will manage the checklist.

A couple clarifying asks from our side:
1) For SIG prefill, can Redwood indicate which fields you can fill out vs which require sample customer evidence (logs, config screenshots)?
2) If SOC 2 final report arrives late Oct/early Nov, is that sufficient for a pilot in mid-Nov, or do you require the final report before pilot start?

We'd appreciate a MAP that shows timeline options (fast/normal).

Thanks,
Eva
Director of IT Security
Medallion Health

On 2026-09-12 16:08, Lauren Bishop wrote:

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Eva Martinez <eva@medallionhealth.com>, Gavin Lee <gavin.lee@medallionhealth.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-09-13T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG prefill: who fills what + MAP options (fast vs standard)

Eva / Gavin —

Thanks for the quick replies — good to know Gavin will own evidence. Attached is a filled example of the SIG prefill where we mark the fields we can prefill (service descriptions, network boundaries, encryption defaults) and the items that generally require customer-supplied evidence (SSO screenshots, vendor contracts, specific config exports).

High-level MAP options (milestones):
- Fast path (4 weeks): sign SOW -> Redwood provides prefill + SOC 2 interim evidence -> Medallion completes evidence checklist -> pilot kickoff. Assumes Medallion can provide interim SOC 2 artifacts within 7–10 business days.
- Standard path (8–10 weeks): same steps but with more time for evidence collection and legal review.

Rishi from our compliance team (cc'd) will take point on technical evidence alignment. Ben will coordinate the prefill delivery and follow-ups.

Specific clarifying asks for Gavin: can you confirm a couple of items so we can mark them in the prefill and avoid back-and-forth?
- Primary IdP (Okta, Azure AD, other) and whether you can share a screenshot of the SSO settings page.
- Retention policy for logs (how many days) and whether logs are retained in-region (US).
- Any third-party subprocessors we should account for on the vendor form.

If it's helpful I can propose calendar slots for a 30-minute handoff between your evidence owner and Rishi.

Thanks — I'll schedule the handoff after I get confirmation on the three items above.

Regards,
Lauren
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_sig_prefill_template_filled_example.xlsx

From: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
To: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-09-14T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: evidence plan & handoff for Medallion Health (DEAL-1287)

Lauren / Rishi —

Thanks — I reviewed the example prefill Lauren attached. Proposed internal plan before we do the handoff:

1) I will prepare a SIG prefill packet that highlights the exact evidence artifacts we can supply vs the artifacts we expect from Medallion (SSO screenshot, log retention policy doc, subprocessors list).
2) Rishi: please flag any redlines on data residency or BAA language we should pre-approve before sending to Gavin.
3) Lauren: propose two 30-min slots (Tue/Wed) for a technical handoff with Gavin. I'll draft the MAP email for the fast and standard options and include clear dates keyed to Gavin's SOC2 timeline.

If SOC2 final report slips to mid-Nov and they can provide interim evidence by early Oct, fast path is still viable — we'll just note the dependency.

Ben
Security Ops, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
